newsitem.title: USA: Alpine Lace to appeal patent decision.
newsitem.headline: Alpine Lace to appeal patent decision.

text.p: A U.S. federal court said Alpine Lace Brands Inc failed to demonstrate that Borden Inc and Schreiber Foods Inc had infringed its patented process for making nonfat cheese, Alpine said on Friday.
But Alpine, which filed a lawsuit in 1995 against Borden, Schreiber and two other defendents for patent infringement, said in a statement it would appeal the decision.
The company said Borden and Schreiber won partial summary judgements from a federal court in Newark, N.J., and it was appealing a similar summary judgement in favor of Kraft.
Proceeds were continuing against Beatrice Cheese, the fourth defendent, Alpine said.
Alpine, which patented a process for making nonfat processed cheese, develops and markets reduced fat and sodium cheeses as well as low fat turkey and ham.
